description: This PHP file contains functions for generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of system memory and swap information, utilizing global variables and external functions for data retrieval and formatting.

methods.name: xml_memory
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing current system memory and swap details.

methods.name: html_memory
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying system memory and swap usage with graphical bars.

methods.name: wml_memory
methods.description: Produces a WML card summarizing system memory and swap information.
